scope: Three fixed social-inspired Nifty FUTURES hypotheses, not replications of undisclosed claims; previously inspected 504-session official NSE archives.

rules.failed_breakout: At spot close t: LONG if low(t)<lowest low of prior20 and close(t)>that level; SHORT if high(t)>highest high of prior20 and close(t)<that level. If both occur skip.
rules.nr7_confirmation: Day t-1 has the uniquely smallest high-low range among t-7..t-1. At t close above t-1 high LONG, below t-1 low SHORT.
rules.inside_confirmation: Day t-1 strictly inside day t-2 high-low range. At t close above t-1 high LONG, below t-1 low SHORT.

common: Next-open actual futures entry. Highest prior-session-volume contract, expiry more than3 calendar days away. Initial stop 1 prior spot ATR14; exit5sessions or3calendar days before expiry. Historical lots, fully reserved notional <=Rs20lakh capital; no leverage, no 0.5% risk cap, no profit target. Entry gap from prior contract close limited to 1 prior spot ATR. Long and short, one position at a time. Worst opening gap stop fills.
costs: 0.05% fees/tax scenario +0.02% slippage per side, double all for stress. Not dated broker tariffs; before personal income tax.
